g.text: Post hoc comparison · Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct · differences from default on 10 development tasks
Both markers show the same task-mean difference. Bars are nominal 95% intervals;
neither method is a validation. Automatic endpoints are unvalidated;
intervals are not simultaneous. Untruncated sampling retains the 512-token cap.
